description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for the Administrator class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It manages proxies, stubs, channels, and object lifetimes for inter-process communication, including registration, lookup, and reference counting of remote objects, as well as job dispatching and server management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages proxies, stubs, channels, and object lifetimes for inter-process communication, including registration, lookup, and reference counting of remote objects.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling IPC messages within the framework.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations that can submit and revoke jobs.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: An implementation of IIPCServer that manages a thread pool for executing IPC jobs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Administrator.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a given action to all registered proxies and dangling proxies.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers interface proxies and stubs for a specific interface.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters interface proxies and stubs for a specific interface.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy instance is valid for a given channel, implementation ID, and interface ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for a proxy object and possibly releases it.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface proxy for a channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface proxy from a channel.
